newsitem.title: CHINA: China courts hear 230,000 economic cases in 1996.
newsitem.headline: China courts hear 230,000 economic cases in 1996.

text.p: China's courts heard more than 230,000 economic cases in 1996, involving nearly 10 billion yuan in funds, the Economic Daily said on Tuesday.
The amount of fines imposed by the courts in these cases totalled about 1.6 billion yuan, the newspaper said.

The illegal economic activities included more than 50,000 cases of smuggling, 18,000 cases of swindling consumers, 58,000 cases of faking goods and 53,000 cases of speculation and profiteering, the newspaper said. It gave no further details.
